vehicles.name: Landspeeder
vehicles.desc:
The most straightforward vehicle to fly, landspeeders are built for following racing lines and drifting through corners. They maintain high speeds and stability despite what's thrown against them.

In the wider galaxy, landspeeders serve a variety of purposes, from pleasure vehicles to city transport rigs. Those used in the Galactic League are specially designed with aggressive, competitive racing in mind.

traits.name: Drift
traits.desc: Use  to drift sharply while maintaining speed.

vehicles.name: Speeder Bike
vehicles.desc:
Small and agile, speeder bikes boast excellent acceleration, but run wide in corners. Their speed and Kinetic Burst capability make up for a lack of stability, particularly on tight corners and narrow lines.

The speeder bike's popularity is evident from its diverse use. From children's hoverbikes to military combat speeders, it's the ideal vehicle to translate to racing.

traits.name: Vectored Thrust
traits.desc: Modulate accelerate and brake to control cornering.

traits.name: Kinetic Burst
traits.desc: Use  for tight cornering, release for a burst of speed.

vehicles.name: Skim Speeder
vehicles.desc:
Skim speeders boast the most grace of racing speeders, banking wide and rolling onto a Knife Edge for advanced maneuvering. Akin more to a starfighter than a hovercar, the skim speeder is loved by those adept at flying with both speed and poise.

Originally designed as a smugglers' vehicle, it was Darius Pax himself who introduced the skim speeder to the racing scene.

traits.name: Streamlined Intakes
traits.desc: Maintain a high top speed via smooth, wide racing lines.

traits.name: Knife Edge
traits.desc: Use  to roll onto a Knife Edge for tighter cornering.

vehicles.name: Podracer
vehicles.desc: Use the Air Brake to hit tighter corners at the cost of reduced speed.
